kai: Quick sync: onboarding is blocking on one long bench job. Idea: define two probe lanes (fast_smoke, deep_replay) and a tiny handshake between ingest and prober to avoid runtime mismatch.

anika: yes. fast_smoke = inline, ~1-2m, 50 stratified samples. deep_replay = async, 200 sequences, simulates full prefix and quant runs.

pat: minimal handshake sketch:
```
handshake:
  lane: "fast_smoke"|"deep_replay"
  simulate_prefix: "none"|"short"|"full"
  golden_set_id: "gold-2026-03"
  warmup_tokens: 128
```

syl: runtime notes: standardize retries (smoke:1 retry infra, replay:0 retries), TTLs (smoke 7d, deep 30d), and require at least one deep_replay pass before stable promotion. Also add quantized comparison in deep_replay.

ci-bot: queued: deep_replay for rwi-small (ETA 90m) - artifact will post when done.

kai: I'll open a short RFC PR with schema + CLI command `rwi prober run --lane fast_smoke --samples 50`.
